profile.name: Nachiket Bejagamwar
profile.title: Software Engineer
profile.summary: Software Engineer specializing in Java backend development with Spring Boot, microservices, and PostgreSQL. Improved application performance through SQL optimization and caching. Built secure, scalable REST APIs with JWT and role-based authorization, and hold an AWS Certified Developer – Associate certification.

bullets: Design and implement backend services with Java, Spring Boot and Hibernate/JPA to support enterprise applications and data persistence.
Implement transaction management and object-relational mapping with Hibernate/JPA to ensure data integrity during enterprise integrations.
Apply full SDLC and DevOps practices, including requirements analysis and Git-based version control, to streamline builds and deployments.
Optimize SQL queries and implement caching to improve response times and enhance overall application stability.
Diagnose and resolve production issues to maintain application performance in hybrid cloud environments.
Developed Android application features in Java using Android Studio, focusing on UI improvements and efficient resource management.
Integrated RESTful APIs via Retrofit to consume backend services and dynamic data, improving app functionality and data flow.
Collaborated in team workflows to apply SDLC practices, deliver quality code, and maintain technical documentation.

projects.name: Xseed.ai
projects.subtitle: Microservices recruitment platform
bullets: Developed REST APIs using Java 17, Spring Boot, JPA, and Hibernate.
Built microservices architecture with Candidate, Recruiter, User, and Report services.
Implemented JWT authentication, role-based authorization, and OAuth login.
Worked with PostgreSQL and MongoDB for application data; used Redis for caching.
Integrated Twilio, Google Calendar/Meet and email services; set up CI/CD with Jenkins, Maven, Bitbucket and Tomcat.

projects.name: Plug & Go EV Station
projects.subtitle: Android EV charging app (Agile, team of 5)
bullets: Built an app letting EV owners find nearby charging stations, reserve slots in real time, and pay via UPI and cards using the Razorpay API.
Developed backend in Java and PHP with MySQL, email-verified authentication, and role-based access for users and admins.
Built the Android app in Java using Android Studio, with Google Maps for station search and navigation.
Validated registration/login, station search, slot reservation, payment and notification flows through test cases (all passed).
